text:
Clara (Design): quick drop 1 'Mini Revision Audit' for the timeline. compact card that shows sha, author, tag (canary/release), and a one-line diff excerpt. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/mini/audit

Ben (PM): nice. request: make the canary tag explicit when metrics are partial. show "canary  partial metrics" so folks don't misread it.

Clara (Design): added a small info link that expands a tiny tooltip: 'This snapshot ran only on a subset of traffic; metrics may be incomplete.'

Ollie (Eng): implementation note: lazy-load the full diff on expand, and include aria-busy while loading. prefer a slide-over confirm for rollback rather than inline to reduce accidental clicks.

Nia (A11y): a11y notes: tag needs aria-label, the tooltip must be keyboard reachable, and confirm dialogue should use role="dialog" with focus trap. also ensure color contrast for the warning icon passes AA.

Clara (Design): updated aria text and bumped contrast. changed CTA to 'Revert to this revision' per PM. ops-bot: snapshot created for 'mini-revision-audit' by Clara at 1768456830

Ben (PM): propose A/B test: popover confirm vs slide-over confirm. metrics: rollback_attempt, rollback_confirm, rollback_undo_5m. schedule a 10min sync after the prototype is up.

Ollie (Eng): i'll prototype lazy loading and the confirm slide-over this sprint. ping me for the event schema.

Clara (Design): thanks all 1 I'll update handoff with aria snippets and experiment IDs.
